# 💳 Content Creator Persona (gws CLI)

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — an agent persona for content work in Workspace: draft in Docs (`gws docs +write`), organize assets in Drive folders, announce finished pieces in Chat (`gws workflow +file-announce`), send review requests by email, and upload media to Drive, with practical tips like keeping a shared Content Calendar Sheet. Distinct from the sibling personas exec-assistant and researcher (lot 31): those cover executive assistance and research workflows; this one is purely about creating, organizing and distributing content. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: the persona assumes the gws-docs, gws-drive, gws-gmail, gws-chat and gws-slides utility skills are loaded and the gws binary is installed and authenticated; it's an operating mode, not automation — the agent still decides what to write and where to publish. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
